options.content: **One page for the call center.** Each tile and graph has an **ⓘ** (hover the title): what it measures, what is normal, what is not, and what to do when it is red. **Colours:** **green** = normal · **amber** = keep an eye on it · **red** = act now · **blue** = a count with no right or wrong number. On graphs, the shaded bands and dashed lines are the same limits. Limits marked *a starting guess* in their ⓘ will be tuned after the first week of real data. **Markers on the graphs:** purple = a new call center release went live · orange = the store pressed Close batch · red = an incident (the call center server or main went quiet). **Times are Eastern** (the store's), even though the agents work in Manila. The page opens on **today so far**; pick **Agent** / **Provider** at the top to narrow it (Provider only narrows the network panels). Bars count per 5 or 15 minutes: the newest bar appears when its window closes. The detailed per-route view is the **Call center** dashboard, the year-long before / after a release view is **Efficiency over time** (links at the top).

panels.title: Agents signed in
panels.description: Agents whose computer checked in during the last ~15 minutes (each signed-in computer sends a clock sample at sign-in and every 5 minutes; an agent who signs out drops off within 15–20 minutes). Normal: the number of agents on shift. 0 is normal while the call center is closed. Not normal: fewer than the rota says while open; ask who can't sign in. No colours: there is no right number. (Falls back to agents who did anything in the last 15 minutes on builds before the clock checks.)

targets.expr: count(count by (staff) (callcenter_clock_offset_milliseconds{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", isp=~"$isp"})) or count(count by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", staff!="nobody"}[15m]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", staff!="nobody"} offset 15m) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", staff!="nobody"}[15m])) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Orders, last hour
panels.description: Orders the agents finished in the last 60 minutes (sent to the store, cashed out, or changes sent on an existing order), whatever the time range above. No right number: it follows the phones. Not normal: 0 during a busy hour while agents are signed in (the call center may not reach the store: check the tiles beside it).

targets.expr: sum((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset 1h or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[1h]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Median order time
panels.description: Over the time range (today by default): half of the orders took less than this, from the agent's first touch (the first digit of the phone number, a customer picked, a screen pop) to done. Idle time before the first touch is not counted. From the 7-day log digest (every finished order), so it is a true median. Normal: under 3 minutes. Amber: 3–5 minutes. Red: over 5 minutes: look at Speed & efficiency below for which step is slow (phone, account, menu, cash out) and which agent. (A starting guess: tune it after the first week of real data.)

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_name="quicc-callcenter", deployment_environment="$env", detail="digest"} | ui_kind="order" | ui_name=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent" | staff=~"$staff" | unwrap ui_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

panels.title: Card success
panels.description: Over the time range: of every time an agent pressed Pay on a card, the share that ended charged. A typo the agent fixes and re-tries counts as one failed try and one success. Normal: 85 % or more (green). Amber: 70–85 %. Red: under 70 %: look at Cards below for the reason (Square refusals, the bank, the network) and the computer; Network & clock tells a bad clock or a slow internet from Square.

targets.expr: sum((max_over_time(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="charge", outcome="ok"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="charge", outcome="ok"} offset $__range or increase(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="charge", outcome="ok"}[$__range]))) / sum((max_over_time(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="tokenize"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="tokenize"} offset $__range or increase(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="tokenize"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Square refusals
panels.description: Over the time range: card entries Square's card box refused before the store saw them: "refused, no reason given" plus "too many tries on this card" (Square blocks a card for about 10 minutes after 2 refusals). The bank's declines are not in this number (they are under Cards). Normal: 0. Amber: 1–2. Red: 3 or more: check the agents' clocks (a clock over 2 minutes off makes Square refuse) and their connection to Square, below. (A starting guess: tune it after the first week of real data.)

targets.expr: sum((max_over_time(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="tokenize", outcome=~"refused|rate_limited"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="tokenize", outcome=~"refused|rate_limited"} offset $__range or increase(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="tokenize", outcome=~"refused|rate_limited"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Wrong clocks now
panels.description: Agents whose computer clock is over 2 minutes off ours right now, or set to a time zone that isn't Manila (last 15 minutes). The agent sees a red banner with the fix. Normal: 0. Red: 1 or more: Square's card box can refuse every card from that computer. Fix: Windows Settings › Time & language › Date & time: turn on "Set time automatically" and "Set time zone automatically" (or pick Manila), then press Check again on the banner.

targets.expr: count(count by (staff) (abs(callcenter_clock_offset_milliseconds{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", isp=~"$isp"}) > 120000) or count by (staff) ((max_over_time(callcenter_clock_bad_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", reason="tz"}[15m]) unless callcenter_clock_bad_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", reason="tz"} offset 15m or increase(callcenter_clock_bad_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", reason="tz"}[15m])) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Slowest to us
panels.description: The worst agent's round trip from their computer to the call center server in the last 15 minutes (p95: 1 in 20 tries was slower). Normal: under 750 ms. Amber: 750 ms – 1.5 s. Red: over 1.5 s: that agent's screens lag and cards may time out; see the round trips per agent and provider below (one agent = their PC or Wi-Fi; everyone on one provider = that provider).

targets.expr: max(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, staff) ((max_over_time(callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", isp=~"$isp", target=~"us"}[15m]) unless callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", isp=~"$isp", target=~"us"} offset 15m or increase(callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", isp=~"$isp", target=~"us"}[15m])))))

panels.title: Slowest to Square
panels.description: The worst agent's time to reach Square's card script and card server in the last 15 minutes (p95). Normal: under 1.5 s. Amber: 1.5–3 s. Red: over 3 s: Square's card box may load slowly or refuse; ask that agent to press Check my connection (the ? sheet).

panels.title: Call center server
panels.description: UP when the call center's server sent its numbers in the last 3 minutes (it sends every 30 seconds). DOWN: the server is stopped, crashed or can't reach this monitoring; the agents can't take orders if it's really down. Check the Lightsail box and its container.

panels.title: main reachable
panels.description: UP when the call center's server reached main (the store's system) on its last check (every minute). DOWN: orders can't reach the store: check main (Store health dashboard) and the home internet.

targets.expr: min(callcenter_main_up{deployment_environment="$env"})

panels.title: Time to main
panels.description: How long main took to answer the call center server's check, averaged over the last 10 minutes (one check a minute). Normal: under 500 ms. Amber: 500 ms – 1.5 s. Red: over 1.5 s: every screen that loads from the store is slow; check main and the store's internet. (A starting guess: tune it after the first week of real data.)

targets.expr: sum(increase(callcenter_main_probe_duration_milliseconds_sum{deployment_environment="$env"}[10m])) / sum(increase(callcenter_main_probe_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env"}[10m]))

panels.title: Old-version pages
panels.description: Open call center pages loaded before the last release (last 5 minutes). They reload by themselves at the first quiet moment, so a few minutes after a release this is normal. Normal: 0. Amber: 1 or more for over 15 minutes: ask that agent to reload the page (F5) when no order is open.

panels.title: Card failures by reason (per 5 min)
panels.description: Why cards failed, from Square's code, per 5 minutes. Bank declined = the card's bank said no (normal now and then: ask for another card). Over limit / no funds = the card has no room. Wrong card details = number, expiry, CVV or ZIP typed or read wrong (read it back with the caller). Refused, no reason = Square's card box said no without a code: usually a computer clock that is off or a bad connection to Square (see Network & clock). Too many tries = Square blocks that card for ~10 minutes. No answer / network = Square or the internet didn't answer. Normal: a few bank declines and typos a day. Not normal: any run of "refused, no reason" or "no answer": it's the computer or the network, not the card.

panels.title: Card outcome vs the network and clock at that moment
panels.description: Every card try with the agent's network and clock as last measured just before it: net good / bad (bad = a failed round trip, us over 1.5 s or Square over 3 s), clock ok / off (over 2 minutes), none = not measured. Normal: almost every row is net good + clock ok. Not normal: failures that cluster on net bad (the internet) or clock off (fix the clock); failures on good + ok point at the card or Square.

panels.title: Card success by network state
panels.description: The card success rate when the agent's network was good vs bad (and not measured) at that moment, over the time range. Normal: "good" at 85 % or more. If "bad" is much lower than "good", the agents' internet is costing cards: fix their connection or provider.

panels.title: Card failed at the call center, charged at the store
At the store instead
panels.description:
Orders where an agent pressed Card and it didn't go through (refused, declined or no answer), and the card was later run on a store terminal instead: the store had to charge a card the call center couldn't. Each case costs the store time on the phone or at the door. Over the time range (today by default). Normal: 0–1 a day. Amber: 2–3. Red: more than 3: look at the reasons and agents beside it. (A starting guess: tune it after the first week of real data.)

**Coming with the next release:** shows No data until the release that sends it is live. (the Pi's `callcenter_card_fallback_to_store_total` {reason, agent, store_tender} and its digest event `card.fallback_to_store`: the agent release after 2026-11-18.)

targets.expr: sum((max_over_time(callcenter_card_fallback_to_store_total{deployment_environment="$env", agent=~"$staff"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_card_fallback_to_store_total{deployment_environment="$env", agent=~"$staff"} offset $__range or increase(callcenter_card_fallback_to_store_total{deployment_environment="$env", agent=~"$staff"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

Amber: 5–10 %. Red: over 10 %. (A starting guess: tune it after the first week of real data.)

panels.title: Charged at the store instead, by reason (per 15 min)
panels.description:
Orders where an agent pressed Card and it didn't go through (refused, declined or no answer), and the card was later run on a store terminal instead: the store had to charge a card the call center couldn't.
